column2: v262144 Lenovo Legion Y700 TB320FC (Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, Adreno 730, Vulkan 1.1, Android 15)

column1: # the 860 MB memory pool as a copied pool: the Legion Y700 2023's gralloc aborts allocating a hardware buffer that big
# handheld (720p) by default: docked 1080p took 34 ms of GPU a frame in battle on that device (about 22 fps), handheld 11-20 ms
# the replay on its own thread: in battle it took 17.5 ms of the game thread's 33 ms a frame (about 3,000 draws), which held the adaptive rate at 30 fps
# colour render targets keep Adreno's UBWC compression: the opening's GPU time 35-40% lower (14 to 8-9 ms at about 550 draws)
# back up to 60 fps judged on the median frame: at 40 its p90 stayed at 21-25 ms though it held 60 with 1-2 of 64 frames late
# the battle map draws ~2,030 of its ~3,500 draws in one pass without depth (13 ms of GPU): split every 512 draws, the GPU starts on it while the replay records the rest
# the replay thread on the prime core: the battle map's replay 12.5 to 10.0 ms a frame (all big cores: no change)
# under one layout only the sets that changed are bound again: the battle map's replay 9.6 to 8.5-8.9 ms a frame
